name: workflow
description: Multi-chat coordination: worktree per task, shared inbox, handoff reports, messaging between chats; on-demand skills for pull requests, new projects, rule changes, subagents, self-driving loops, ADR writing and experiments that may replace a working design; hooks that keep chats in sync with GitHub (state line on each message, no push to a merged branch), keep the main checkout current and free of git work, remove worktrees whose PR merged, and release claims of closed chats.
